name: skill-agent-brigade
description: A brigade for building skills: a multi-agent assembly line (spec -> tests -> author -> critic, with a convergence loop) that turns a one-line request + a competency source into a depth-forced, well-tested SKILL.md and gates slop with independent critics. Stations hand off through file artifacts; the expo routes each ticket (advance / refire-to-author / reroute-to-spec / reroute-to-steward / kill). Ships the steward (front-of-house context curation), the expo, reference workflows (single-ticket + rail queue-walk), and a worked example (variance-analysis).
